vision.name: Black Ominous Mastery
vision.text:
(You cannot win by MPPV.)
[Continuous]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage and +1 life card.
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects discards the last card in your opponent's hand. Advance or lower your MP 1 level.
POWER: Banish the top 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile. The next time one of your Styled effects discards a card from your opponent's hand during combat, the card is chosen at random.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip read from a crop; DR number printed; Set 19 uses a new gold wolf crest as set symbol; disclaimer line mentions 'Dragon Ball Daima'
